name: animated-list
title: Animated List
description: A vertical feed of notification cards that appear one after another with a spring, newest on top, pushing the earlier cards down as the list grows.
use: A landing page wants to show recent activity building up in front of the visitor.
avoid: Long feeds: the demo caps at five items, so older entries drop out of view.
a11y: Cards are clickable divs with no keyboard focus and the emoji icons have no labels; new items are not announced. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A stack of dark notification cards centred on black, newest at the top. Each card has a small coloured rounded-square icon with an emoji, a bold title, a relative time and a one-line subtitle.
behaves: Cards spring in at the top one at a time and push earlier ones down; the list fills to five items and stops. Hovering a card scales it up slightly.
customise: Pass the cards as children and set the per-item delay; the spring easing and stacking behaviour are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A handful of motion divs with one spring each; idle once the list is full.
demo: Notifications: Payment received, New follower, New message, Order shipped and Meeting reminder.
issues: The cards are clickable divs rather than buttons, so they cannot be reached by keyboard.
polishWhy: Pleasant spring entrance and a tidy card design; the demo stops at five items.
